title: Indigo Oasis, Pool, Sleeps 18
description:
This indigo oasis home can fit up to 18 guests with its 6 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. With lots of upscale amenities and a stunning heated pool iin the backyard, this home is your ultimate travel destination. Filled with sunlight and professionally selected décor, this airy and classy home is custom-designed for large groups to experience extravagant living. The professionally designed spaces offer open-concept layouts and kitchen & dining spaces perfect for entertaining.

 The space 
This listing is for the entire home and is private. The home is on one floor and does not require stairs.

FEATURES

–1 indoor kitchen fully stocked with essential cookware
–Backyard with heated pool, putting green, ping pong table, and BBQ grill
–Outdoor fire pit with seating area
–2 off-street parking spots available
–High-quality memory foam mattresses and linen
–High-speed internet
–High-end essential toiletries
–1 TV located in the living room

ACCESSIBILITY & LAYOUT

This property is a single-story home. No interior stairs besides a few small steps up and down from the inside to the outside.

Bedroom 1: 1 Queen Bed
Bedroom 2: 1 King Bed
Bedroom 3: 2 Queen Beds
Bedroom 4: 2 Queen Beds 
Bedroom 5: 1 King Bed, ensuite full bathroom 
Bedroom 6: 2 Full Beds

Additional Rooms:
Living Room, Kitchen, Dining Area, Laundry Room

Outdoor Space: This home includes a backyard and patio. The backyard has a heated pool with loungers and a putting green. The deck next to the backyard provides a pergola with a outdoor seating area with a propane fire pit and an outdoor dining area.

HOST INFORMATION

Stay Heirloom professionally manages a collection of handcrafted homes designed to bring your group together.

 Guest access 
The unit has locks with door codes. Codes and other check-in details will be provided via message and texted to your phone on the day of check-in.

 Other things to note 
HOUSE DISCLOSURES
–We try our best to accommodate early check-ins, but we want to ensure the entirety of the spacious estate is clean and prepared for arrival. We can often accommodate early bag drop for your convenience. Please inquire if this is of interest to your group.
–The pool is open and heated from Labor Day through Memorial Day. If you are booking dates bordering these holidays and are interested in having the pool heated, please let us know and we will determine if this request can be accommodated with our winterizing schedule.

BUSINESS DISCLAIMERS
–We have a minimum age requirement for booking this rental. Reservation holder must be 21 years or older.
–We request that guests complete a guest verification process and sign an additional agreement prior to receiving any check-in information. 
–We require that guests provide a valid credit card and piece of ID for identification purposes only. 
–We do not accept peer-to-peer payment systems or any prepaid debit cards as methods of payment. 
–Pets are not allowed at this property. 
–Packages mailed to the property cannot be received by the host. The host is not responsible for lost or damaged packages and cannot guarantee their arrival. 
–We use Arlo and Noise Aware in our homes. Arlo is a video recording system that has been installed at the front/back doors of the home’s EXTERIOR ONLY, for your safety. NoiseAware is a decibel monitoring system that we use to keep in accordance with local noise regulations.

Permit Number: 21475445
